A [[Glob of Ectoplasm]] is a [[rare crafting material]]. It is used in the [[craft]]ing of  [[Obsidian armor]] and [[Chaos Gloves]]. 

==Acquisition==
* Purchased from [[rare material trader]]s.
* Random [[drop]] from creatures in [[Ruins of the Tomb of the Primeval Kings]], [[Scarred Psyche]], [[The Fissure of Woe]] ([[Banshee]]), and [[The Underworld]]. For known creatures that drop Globs of Ectoplasm see [[:Category:Drops ectoplasm]].
* Always drops from the [[Underworld Chest]].
* [[Expert Salvage Kit|Expert salvaged]] from armor crafted with Globs of Ectoplasm.
** No [[salvage item]]s, [[Trophy|trophies]], or [[weapon]]s currently appear to [[:Category:Contains ectoplasm|contain Globs of Ectoplasm]].

==Crafting==
*Armor
**[[Obsidian armor]]
**[[Chaos Gloves]]

==Notes==
* '''Ecto''' and '''e''' are abbreviated terms for Globs of Ectoplasm.
*For a variety of reasons, ''ectos'' have become the primary alternative [[currency]] for player trades and are almost always used for transactions exceeding {{cost|100000}} (e.g. something worth {{Cost|150000}} would be traded as "{{Cost|100000}} +''X'' e" (with ''X'' ectos being valued at {{Cost|50000}}). Other items such as [[Zaishen Key]]s and [[Armbrace of Truth|Armbraces of Truth]] are used as well for the same purposes.
* Beware of [[scam]]s: Globs of Ectoplasm have a similar icon to other items (such as [[Mursaat Token]]). Double-check before completing a trade.
** [[Glob of Frozen Ectoplasm|Globs of Frozen Ectoplasm]], a [[Wintersday]] item, ''cannot'' be converted into regular Globs of Ectoplasm under any circumstances.

==Trivia==
*[[W:Ectoplasm (paranormal)|Ectoplasm]] is a term coined to refer to a theoretical substance that is associated with the formation of ghosts or the remnants of a haunting or possession.
